current_suggestion.pitch: Muthukrishna is a cultural evolutionary psychologist at LSE whose work sits at the intersection of collective intelligence, institutional design, and how societies make good decisions — a rigorous empirical counterweight to the Munger/Kahneman mental-models tradition you already consume. Where your current channels focus on individual cognition and decision-making, he zooms out to ask why some groups and cultures systematically think better than others, grounded in actual data. Format is a mix of lectures and long-form interviews, consistently high depth with no pop-psychology shortcuts.
